node.title: DLI odd-phase budget ledger soundness
node.statement: If a DLI odd-phase ledger covers every central profile, nonzero frequency, harmonic, and square-root component; marks every phase non-Artin-Schreier; and supplies reduced polar-divisor bounds whose harmonic total is o(t), then dli_odd_phase_reduced_pole_budget holds.
node.attack_surface: formal coverage and summation rule for DLI reduced-pole ledgers
node.falsifier: a complete ledger with all phases marked nontrivial and total o(t) while the reduced-pole budget statement fails
